summary: Mature-project rescue, evidence-backed recovery, and proactive AI project management / 成熟项目救援、证据化恢复与积极型 AI 项目管理

excluded: Automatic production access, product command execution, dependency installation, destructive Git action, merge, tag, Release, rollback, business Decision, or human UAT approval / 自动访问生产、运行产品命令、安装依赖、执行破坏性 Git、合并、tag、Release、回滚、业务 Decision 或人工 UAT 批准
Automatic live Linear import from rescue_project.py; v1.0 emits an approved-boundary dry-run package only / rescue_project.py 自动实时导入 Linear；v1.0 只生成符合批准边界的 dry-run 包
deferred: Automatic CI provider configuration for arbitrary rescued projects / 为任意被救援项目自动配置 CI provider
Open-source marketplace publication and cross-agent compatibility certification / 开源市场发布与跨 Agent 兼容性认证

safety.destination: Current private GitHub repository and GitHub Release
safety.review_disposition: The isolated private candidate safety gate is clean. Overall publication remains pending Owner UAT and explicit authorization.

rollback.plan: Install the prior immutable OS package on a dedicated branch while preserving local overrides, audit and Linear history, safety dispositions, discovery evidence, rescue evidence, and private runtime context.
rollback.verification: Run upgrade verification, strict validator, all tests, private safety gate, and project-specific UAT before accepting the rollback.

known_limitations: Mechanical evidence cannot prove unavailable production behavior; high-impact gaps require human verification.
Codex still supplies project-specific reasoning for declared contradictions and Decisions; deterministic tooling validates and routes those claims but does not replace engineering judgment.
Product commands and dependency installation are intentionally not executed during rescue inspection.
Linear rescue output is a proposal only; actual duplicate checks and writes use the separate authorized Linear workflow.
The free Linear workspace issue limit requires the attached v1.0 Project Document as the current equivalent requirement record.
Public or team publication profiles may produce additional safety Review or Block findings.
